checks.basisJa: WEB13:31,17:1,17:2 contain Manasseh as ancestor while also speaking of his descendants/tribe; both usages are retained at those dual coordinates. WEB17:3 is genealogy alone; the individual context retains it, and the collective base does not. The current context proposal SHA is the post-source-correction version, and its 17:2 wording is now “ヨセフの子マナセの子ら”.

WEB15:6 and18:17 name “the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben”; these are not references to the Reubenite collective. Staging removes them from base passages and retains them in the unidentified-eponym context.

WEB14:4 explicitly defines Joseph’s children as the tribes of Manasseh and Ephraim; individual Joseph appears in the 17:1 genealogy and 24:32 burial. At 24:32 base and individual context coexist under one stable ID; runtime shows the context note alongside base rather than a duplicate occurrence.
